crossRefs.note: She brought it before Saul, and before his servants; and they ate. Then they rose up, and went away that night.

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: She brought it before Saul, and before his servants; and they ate. Then they rose up, and went away that night.
translations.bsb: She served it to Saul and his servants, and they ate. And that night they got up and left.
translations.kjv: And she brought it before Saul, and before his servants; and they did eat. Then they rose up, and went away that night.
translations.asv: and she brought it before Saul, and before his servants; and they did eat. Then they rose up, and went away that night.
